prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin to establish rules for specific kinds of changes, as no change type has been tested at least twice.
Predictions were consistently too high in both tests conducted so far.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -1.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -3.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Postponed Account Link Flow: Move sign-in after pet adoption so users personalize and adopt their pet before being prompted to create or access an account. (why: Sign-in conversion drops 27.1% early on; allowing users to complete pet creation first increases emotional investment before account setup.)
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop Preview and Controls Introduction: Insert a visual preview screen after waiting that demonstrates how the pet appears on the desktop and how to hide or interact with it. (why: Support receives multiple inquiries regarding pets not appearing or users being confused on how to control and hide pets.)
2: [finish, new_flow] First Interaction Guided Mini Flow: Transform the home intro screen into a spotlight interactive experience where users complete a quick test action with their desktop pet. (why: 35.2% of users drop off at the final step, and support tickets highlight post-onboarding confusion around pet controls.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account Reassurance & Sync Banner: Display explicit hint text explaining that signing in backs up pets and saves progress across desktop sessions. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back into the app.)
4: [home, wait_info] Generation Progress & Estimated Time: Add an explicit progress indicator, time estimate, and informative tips to the waiting screen while generating pet assets. (why: Home phase wait time averages 2336s, leading to drop-offs and stall reports.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Split Choice Path Redesign: Update choose_path layout to a split view clearly distinguishing quick adoption from photo-based creation. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is high (514s), signaling confusion over options.)
6: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Quality Guidance: Provide clear upload criteria hints and tip carousels on the upload_photos screen. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or distorted visual outcomes.)
7: [finish, layout] Two Column Final Onboarding Summary: Reformat home_intro to a two-column view presenting the certificate preview alongside key desktop shortcut tips. (why: Finish step drop-off is 35.2% with a long mean duration of 5815s.)
